thread:
sre-oncall: seeing a gap — multiple notify-proxy delivery_failed alerts since 10:12 UTC but incidentbot didn't page ops. any ideas?

pagerbot: automated delivery report: attempts=4, last_status=502 Bad Gateway, retries queued. sample log:
```
POST /webhook -> 502
resp_body: "upstream connect error or disconnect"
headers (truncated view): X-Signature: sha256=ab12...
```

alex: i can see the alerts in the queue but not the final page events. @pagerbot can you dump the last webhook headers & payload for id=9edc7f?

pagerbot: dump for id=9edc7f -> payload: {"alert":"notify-proxy.delivery_failed","id":"9edc7f"}
headers: X-Signature: sha256=ab12cd34ef56gh78ij (truncated by proxy), X-Env: (missing)

kim: that header truncation pattern rings a bell — we deployed an nginx tweak for HTTP/2 header buffering yesterday to pagerchain-proxy. looks like long headers get cut off which breaks signature verification at the downstream webhook, causing 502s.

alex: can we do a manual page in the meantime? paging automation is down and customers might be affected.

kim: doing manual escalation now -> /page oncall --method phone --reason "notify-proxy webhook failing"

ops-bot: Manual escalation executed. Notifying oncall via SMS and Slack DM. :phone:

sam: i got the SMS and acknowledged. quick check: customer impact estimate: 3 customer-facing incidents didn't get pages, about ~15 internal alerts delayed. tagging as SEV3 until resolved.

kim: opening PR to revert the nginx header change (PR #1342). mitigation: reroute outgoing webhooks to fallback endpoint `https://notify-backup.internal` until prod patch lands. I'll apply routing in 5m.

alex: applied temporary routing. running deliveries to fallback now.

pagerbot: delivery check -> fallback endpoint results: 5/5 success, queued=0. original endpoint still returning 502.

sre-oncall: good. root cause appears to be prod proxy dropping/truncating long headers after the H2 config tweak. immediate actions: revert prod proxy change (PR #1342), add header-length integration test, update runbook with manual reroute steps and how to trigger fallback endpoint.

kim: rolling patch out in ~10m, will monitor.

sam: monitoring shows pages flowing, customers notified. marking ops as aware and will include in postmortem.

sre-oncall: thanks all — I'll open the postmortem and assign follow-ups. keeping monitoring for 30m before closing.
